intel.title: [CISA KEV] Microsoft Office - Microsoft Office Outlook Missing User Interaction for Potentially Unsafe Action Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-124194
廠商: Microsoft
產品: Office
漏洞名稱: Microsoft Office Outlook Missing User Interaction for Potentially Unsafe Action Vulnerability
說明: Microsoft Office Outlook contains a missing user interaction for potentially unsafe action vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-24
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: CISA 將 Microsoft Office Outlook 漏洞（CVE-2026-124194）列入已知遭利用漏洞清單（KEV）。該漏洞源於未對潛在不安全操作要求使用者互動，遠端未授權攻擊者可利用此漏洞於網路上進行欺騙（Spoofing）攻擊。
analysis.recommendation: 請 IT 管理部門（RR40）針對公司內部使用的 M365 商務版與相關 Office 軟體派送最新的安全修補更新，並依 CISA 建議於修補截止日（2026-11-24）前完成所有終端裝置的 Microsoft Office 軟體更新。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder - Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder Incorrect Resource Transfer Between Spheres Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-111793
廠商: Openwave Messaging Limited
產品: Webtop Media Transcoder
漏洞名稱: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder Incorrect Resource Transfer Between Spheres Vulnerability
說明: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability that may allow an authenticated user to process and convert unintended document types if bypassing the Webmail experience.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-24
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: Openwave Messaging Limited 的 Webtop Media Transcoder 存在跨領域資源轉移不當漏洞（CVE-2026-111793）。經身份驗證的攻擊者若繞過 Webmail 體驗，可藉此漏洞轉換並處理未授權的文件類型。該漏洞已被收錄於 CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) 目錄中。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Cisco BroadWorks - Cisco BroadWorks Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-20320
廠商: Cisco
產品: BroadWorks
漏洞名稱: Cisco BroadWorks Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference Vulnerability
說明: Cisco BroadWorks contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information on an affected system.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-24
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: Cisco BroadWorks 存在 XML 外部實體參照漏洞（CVE-2026-20320），未經身份驗證的遠端攻擊者可藉此讀取受影響系統上的敏感設定資訊。此漏洞已被 CISA 列入已知遭利用漏洞清單（KEV），並要求限期完成修補。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Barracuda Networks Multiple Products - Barracuda Networks Multiple Products OS Command Injection Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-111560
廠商: Barracuda Networks
產品: Multiple Products
漏洞名稱: Barracuda Networks Multiple Products OS Command Injection Vulnerability
說明: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG), Load Balancer, Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Message Archiver (BMA), WAF Control Center (WCC), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Web Security Gateway (WSG) contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an authenticated administrator to inject OS commands that execute with root privileges when the crafted timezone value is subsequently processed. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-116606
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-13
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: Barracuda Networks 多項產品（包含 ESG、WAF、ADC 等）存在 OS 命令注入漏洞（CVE-2026-111560）。已通過驗證的管理者可利用精心設計的時區設定值，以 root 權限執行任意作業系統命令。該漏洞已被 CISA 列入已遭利用漏洞清單（KEV）。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Barracuda Networks Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG) - Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-116606
廠商: Barracuda Networks
產品: Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG)
漏洞名稱: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
說明: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-111560.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-13
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG) 存在驗證旁路漏洞（CVE-2026-116606），遠端未經身份驗證的攻擊者可藉此觸發設定匯入功能並還原惡意備份，進而篡改設備全域設定。此漏洞已被 CISA 列入已知被利用漏洞清單（KEV）並要求的限期修補。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Google Chromium - Google Chromium Use-After-Free Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-125350
廠商: Google
產品: Chromium
漏洞名稱: Google Chromium Use-After-Free Vulnerability
說明: Google Chromium contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XML component that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a specially crafted webpage. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-24
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: Google Chromium 存在 XML 元件之 Use-After-Free 釋放後重用漏洞（CVE-2026-125350），遠端攻擊者可透過特製網頁在沙盒環境內執行任意程式碼。此漏洞已被 CISA 收錄於已知遭利用漏洞清單（KEV），影響包含 Chrome 及 Edge 等多款基於 Chromium 之瀏覽器。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。
